title: Masala dosa
prompt: Teach children how to make masala dosa step by step in simple English.

actions.text: Hello, little chefs! I'm MAYA. Let's make a crispy masala dosa.
sentences: Hello, little chefs!

actions.text: Wash your hands. Ask a grown-up to use the hot stove and utensils.

actions.text: We need dosa batter, cooked potato filling, a little oil, and chutney.
